journal.text: First session, fresh $50k cash. Reviewed price history for ~50 of the 96 eligible large-cap growth names through 2025-06-30. Regime is clearly risk-on with AI/compute leadership: 2-mo gains STX +55%, MU +53%, LITE +51%, AMD +44%, NVDA +38%, ZS +36%, AVGO +35%, ARM/LRCX +31%, CEG +30%, KLAC +28%, DDOG +28%, INTU +25%, MRVL/META +24%. Mega-cap platforms participating (MSFT +14%, AMZN +15%). Laggards: healthcare (REGN -13%, VRTX -11%), staples/retail (COST -2%, ORLY -4%), WDAY -3.5%, AAPL flat. Built a 16-name momentum-tilted growth book: semis (NVDA 5k, AVGO 3.5k, AMD 3k, MU 2.5k, ASML 2.5k), AI infra (STX 2.5k, LITE 2k, CEG 2.5k), platforms (MSFT 4k, META 3.5k, AMZN 3k, GOOGL 2.5k), software (CRWD 2k, INTU 2k), internet (NFLX 2.5k, MELI 2k). ~$45k deployed, ~$5k cash buffer plus monthly deposits for adds. Used dollar (notional) orders so overnight gaps cannot mis-size fills; no sells needed as buys are cash-funded. Reconsider if leaders break trend (NVDA/AVGO/AMD lose momentum), breadth narrows further or a risk-off/rates shock hits; otherwise hold and top up on deposits.

Session 2 (2025-07-02). No new deposit (next is Aug 1). Reviewed closes through 2025-07-01: a broad, high-volume down day hit the whole AI/momentum complex I hold — NVDA -3.0%, AVGO -4.0%, AMD -4.1%, LITE -3.8%, CEG -4.6%, MELI -4.3%, NFLX -3.4%, CRWD -3.4%, META -2.6%. My 7/1 journal said to reconsider if leaders lose momentum; this is that signal. However the intermediate trend (2-3 wk) is still up on almost everything, so I am NOT dumping the book. Action: de-risk modestly by exiting AMD (weakest — down ~8% from its 6/27 high, duplicative high-beta semi exposure) and CEG (AI-power theme reversing hard), raising ~$5.3k and cutting AI concentration from ~8 names to ~6. Cash goes to ~$10.3k (~21%). Kept all platform/software/internet leaders (NVDA, AVGO, MU, ASML, STX, LITE, MSFT, META, AMZN, GOOGL, CRWD, INTU, NFLX, MELI). Used share units (equal to full holdings) so a gap can't oversell. Plan: hold core; if the pullback proves a one-day dip (bounce on strong volume), redeploy cash into leaders; if weakness broadens for 2-3 more sessions, trim more high-beta names (LITE, MELI). Full ~$50k August deposit earmarked for adds on confirmed trend.

Session 3 (2025-07-03). No deposit (next Aug 1). Read through 2025-07-02: the 7/1 down-day was followed by a MIXED 7/2 that revealed a leadership ROTATION, not a breakdown. New highs on strong volume: STX +4.8% (6.7M), AMAT +3.4%, KLAC +2.5%, TXN new high, QCOM +1.8%, AAPL +2.2% (68M vol), NVDA +2.6% rebound, LRCX +2.1%. Meanwhile my cooling names kept distributing: MELI -5.4% in 2 sessions (broke 2500), NFLX broke below 1300, MU rolled 128->121.7, LITE 95->91.2; froth (PLTR/ARM/APP/MRVL) also correcting. This satisfies my 7/2 stated trigger ('if weakness broadens 2-3 sessions, trim more high-beta LITE/MELI') AND partially the redeploy condition, so I act: exit the four broken high-beta positions (MELI, NFLX, MU, LITE), raising ~$8.7k. Redeploy into confirmed leadership: add STX (strongest holding, breakout) and NVDA (leader), open AMAT (semi-capex new high), AAPL (mega-cap new-high diversifier) and top up GOOGL (platform held and bounced). ~$10.5k deployed, cash back to ~$8.5k (~17%). Kept AVGO, ASML, MSFT, META, AMZN, CRWD, INTU. Reconsider: if the new-high leaders (AMAT/KLAC/TXN/AAPL/STX) fail their breakouts or the S&P/mega-caps close below the 7/1 lows, cut semi exposure and raise more cash; if breadth broadens and my cooling names (META, INTU) bottom, rotate back. Full ~$50k Aug 1 deposit earmarked for adds on a confirmed uptrend.

Session 4 (2025-07-07). No deposit (next Aug 1). Read through 2025-07-03 (a July-4 half session, so low volume across the board is holiday-related, not a red flag). The tape confirmed my 7/3 rotation thesis: the semi-capex/megacap leadership I moved into kept breaking out on the last full sessions. New-high closes: AMAT 191.05, KLAC 924.58, LRCX 98.81, TXN 216.02, QCOM 162.21, AAPL 213.55 (new high), NVDA 159.34 (new high), MSFT 498.84, CRWD 514.10 (fully recovered the 7/1 hit), AMZN 223.41, GOOGL 179.53. My book is intact and near highs: NVDA, AVGO, ASML, STX, MSFT, META, AMZN, GOOGL, CRWD, INTU, AMAT, AAPL. The 7/1 down-day was bought; trend is up, breadth is broadening into the semi complex. Sitting on ~17% cash in a confirmed uptrend is a drag, so I deploy ~$5.0k (notional orders so overnight gaps can't mis-size buys) into confirmed leadership: add NVDA (strongest AI leader, new-high close), add AAPL (lower-beta megacap new high, diversifies away from semis), open KLAC (semi-capex leader, clean new high, complements AMAT). Cash drops to ~$3.6k (~7% buffer) ahead of the Aug 1 deposit. Kept all existing names; INTU/META still lag their highs but I hold for now. Reconsider: if these new-high leaders fail their breakouts or the market closes back below the 7/1 lows (NVDA 151.5, etc.), cut semi exposure and raise cash; if the cooling names (META, INTU) keep distributing, swap them for confirmed leaders; otherwise hold and add on the Aug 1 deposit.

Session 5 (2025-07-08). No deposit (next Aug 1). Read through 2025-07-07: a modest, slightly higher-volume pullback in the momentum complex after the 7/1-7/3 run - AAPL -1.7% (209.95), GOOGL -1.5% (176.79), CRWD -1.7% (505.46), KLAC -1.3% (912.62), ASML -1.2%, NVDA -0.7% (158.24), STX -0.7%; MSFT/META/AMZN/INTU/AMAT flat. No holding broke a prior swing low and no breakout failed; the intermediate trend across the whole book (NVDA, AVGO, ASML, STX, MSFT, META, AMZN, GOOGL, CRWD, INTU, AMAT, AAPL, KLAC) is still up. My 7/7 triggers - leaders failing breakouts, or the complex closing back below the 7/1 lows - were NOT hit, so no selling. Cash is thin at ~$3.6k (~7%); with earnings season starting mid-July and a full ~$50k deposit due Aug 1, I hold the buffer rather than chase a stalling tape. Action: HOLD all positions, zero trades. Reconsider: if leaders fail key levels (AMAT 188, KLAC 905, AAPL 208, NVDA 155) or the complex closes below its 7/1 lows, trim semi/AI beta and raise cash; if the tape resumes new highs, deploy current cash plus the Aug 1 deposit into leadership (NVDA/AMAT/KLAC/AAPL); watch the laggard META for a real break vs. its 713 consolidation floor.

Session 7 (2025-07-10). No deposit (next Aug 1). Read through 2025-07-09: a broad NEW-HIGH session, not a mixed tape. New-high closes: NVDA 162.88 (strong volume), AMAT 195.39, MSFT 503.51, KLAC 923.18 (near highs), CRWD 513.51, ASML 799.83, AVGO 277.90; META 732.78 broke out of its 713-737 range. BUT my explicit STX trigger WAS hit: I said 'if it loses 142.6 I trim it' and STX closed 142.01 - a 4th down day on rising volume, fully round-tripping its 7/2 breakout and now at a loss (avg 147.7). Reconsider: if ASML's print breaks the semis lower, stop adding and cut semi beta (leaders fail: AMAT 188, KLAC 905, NVDA 155); if META keeps closing under ~709 I exit the residual; if the tape stays constructive post-ASML, deploy the buffer plus the Aug 1 deposit into leadership.

(2) ASML broke its trend decisively on earnings; per plan to cut broken semi beta, EXIT the full position (~$2.4k). Both are sell-laggard moves, not panic. (3) With the tape constructive I redeploy part of the resulting ~$10.5k cash into leadership: add PLTR $3.0k (AI software, new highs) and GOOGL $2.0k (new highs), both notional so gaps cannot mis-size. I deliberately do NOT add to GOOGL/MSFT/AAPL/AMZN/KLAC just ahead of their late-July prints; keep ~$3.0k (~6%) dry into the earnings cluster and KLAC's ~7/24 report. Hold all core. (2) TRIM KLAC ~half (~$1.4k) into the 7/24 binary per plan ('trim KLAC ahead of 7/24 if it rolls over'), keeping a residual. (3) Redeploy part into leadership with NO imminent earnings: add AVGO $2.5k notional (AI-ASIC/networking leader, new high 7/17, reports ~Sept), staying invested in the intact AI-compute theme while cutting WFE capex beta (equipment design risk vs fabless demand). Hold NVDA/MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/AAPL/PLTR; I do NOT add ahead of the earnings cluster (GOOGL ~7/23, KLAC 7/24, MSFT/AAPL/AMZN ~7/29-31) and keep ~$5.6k (~11%) dry. Hold all other core: NVDA/AVGO/MSFT/AMZN/GOOGL/AAPL/PLTR - no stops triggered and I will not fight the still-intact uptrend (GOOGL/AAPL firm). I do NOT add into the densest earnings cluster of the quarter (GOOGL 7/23, MSFT/AAPL/AMZN 7/29-31); the semi pullback plus a stop-out argues for patience, not fresh buys.
